scope: AE-matched bidirectional graph, constant lr .001 and no weight decay; fresh GIDS and optimized mixed-read DiGiT random/BFS64
graph: AE bidirectional multigraph: append reverse edges, retain parallel edges, one self edge per node; explicit int64 CSC-position EIDs
graph_limit: Adjacency hashes match AE; internal EID labels use CSC positions and no model edge features
root_order: Explicit per-epoch permutation; random or 64-node BFS chunks rotated and reshuffled; no DGL reshuffle
seed_limit: historical random state absent from user log; this run explicitly seeds 0
optimizer_origin: AE selected optimizer; fixed for all three arms
evaluation: AE bidirectional validation/test traces; each epoch valid, epoch20 test once; CPU features outside training
primary_timing: synchronized wall time around iterator creation and complete training loop; setup and post-run audits excluded; no sum of nested timers
legacy_timing_diagnostic: sample + inclusive fetch + model host spans retained explicitly as overlapping, not as E2E
fixes: drain window and merged results after upstream EOF
support sub-controller-page cache geometry and PRP offsets
affinity_scope: Apply to all existing worker threads immediately before iteration; future threads inherit; setup uses inherited affinity in both arms
digit_cpu_hotset: Unchanged directed-profile frequency hot set from mixed-read predecessor; held fixed to isolate graph and optimizer
features: original real float32 values; reordered physical rows for DiGiT
group_read_policy: Pair two present CPU-cold g2 members within a batch; both GPU misses use one 1KiB DMA with scatter; partial miss uses 512B; unmatched/CPU-hot uses unchanged single-row path
gpu_admission: Includes 32 bytes per 512-B physical range entry, exact CPU alias map, compact sampler metadata and retained window batches
accumulator_bound_scope: Same bounds for both arms; one oversized batch may run alone without splitting roots
admission_policy: Phase maximum plus explicit 4 GiB runtime reserve; stage checks; anonymous host CSC copies
